verdict.rationale: Kintsugi documents importing historical transactions via CSV upload and connectors, and uses a lookback window to find when nexus thresholds were crossed and when filing obligations began. Its marketing says it 'finds the exposure you didn't know you had.' Nothing in the pack shows quantified per-jurisdiction exposure output, so this is a partial match. Missing for 10: documented estimated back-tax liability amounts per jurisdiction, penalty and interest estimates, an exposure report view or API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
